data.name: P.A.C.
data.detailed_description:
Under the grip of a global mind virus, your friend has been lured back to the decaying ruins of their old high school, a place abandoned since the outbreak first began. The virus doesn't just infect the body; it feeds on memory, emotion... nostalgia. Now, it's using the past as bait.

In this asymmetric coop horror, you must collect diodes to fix the electrical boxes and illuminate the halls of your old school. Only then can you locate little mementos that remind your Ill friend who he really is. There's only one issue. He is the only thing trying to stop you.

Vault through windows and slam doors in his face to slow down his pursuit and DON"T GET HIT. Once you collect all mementos and the virus no longer can feast on its host. That's when you all make your final escape. Good luck running away from your past.

data.short_description: A co-op survival horror game where players hunt memories and sever the grip of a parasitic mind virus. Scavenge, strategize, and outsmart an evolving threat as you work together to rescue your fallen friend before nostalgia consumes them completely. The only thing stopping him from your help is him.
